key_insight: The paper builds a high-fidelity numerical database of bypass transition in boundary layers that fills major gaps left by experimental benchmarks.
engineering_relevance: This dataset can improve transition prediction models for aerodynamic and turbomachinery design by providing full-field, time-resolved validation data.
method: Wall-resolved implicit LES (iLES) of ERCOFTAC T3-like flat-plate boundary layers
High-order compressible Navier–Stokes solver across multiple freestream turbulence and pressure-gradient cases
Benchmarking against standard RANS transition models (SA-BCM and k-ω-γ)
evidence_signal: The simulations show satisfactory agreement with legacy experiments for skin friction, mean velocity, and fluctuation profiles, while RANS transition models exhibit systematic errors in onset and transition length.
watch_item: The database is highly detailed but still tailored to a specific bypass-transition setup, so transferring conclusions to other geometries or transition mechanisms should be done carefully.
paper_title: A high-fidelity numerical database for free-stream transition
